content: Engel sewen beĩ sewen adodo anĩ takam isi fen, aya irokanan, “Usi, aya kayau bouwa na sur fedig odug, ĩ naan musei teten ibodõdig anĩ nẽ kafĩ fiya afelnõf.
Tenebur nẽ king, ĩ geid seseirã tobonunã dino di, tamo kayau tenebur difaref anidi, yogon seseirã tobonunã nẽ wain bunem, idi meleid waĩ yen.”
Age ye fen, engel ĩ Awa Uur bunem aya gerere tuan yale irouleyan. An aya, kayau, gaar kuĩ giriya, bouwa bun kono fiya yeneid barikã, mudur sewen ado, karat ten anĩ teten ibod mog, ailen.

Kayau ĩ, kolos giriya tu releya medeĩya ado giriya bagai ifoun ken, gol, meein meli bagai ado, maaĩ tuwa meli bagai pel naki yen. Ĩ gol kap, ninir safineid ado yogon seseirã tobonunã nẽ sisik isokosen anĩ imam iroun.
Waa nẽ yana are, yogon dama bun ditoton: BABILON ODUG KAYAU BOUWEID NA SUR FIYA ADO TENEBUR NINIR IBODOK ANIDI NEID SINA.
Aya, kayau, Negur nẽ tamo kayau neid naudeid ado, idi Jesus nẽ od kurõ difesin anidi, nedi naudeid yokon, mala waĩ ye mog, ailen. Aya kayau anĩ ail fen, fatuk bagai terẽ aun.
Age afe di, engel aya irokanan, “Õ ere nigin terẽ wof? Aya, õ, kayau nẽ waa ado, gaar kuĩ kayau anĩ teten ibodõdig, ĩ mudur sewen ado fen, karat ten ado anĩ nẽ waa anĩ faded ayõf.

Gaar kuĩ ulen are, kulu ibodon, gama ibodõya sã, agef fen, ĩ ku isil idĩya sã bunem ulõ yeis fen, yogo daũ falauf bun ilauf. Tamo kayau tenebur dibodok anidi, saa teneub ado kare fen sain bunem isin, idi yeneid mata ibodõya nẽ buk bun to itoton, idi gaar kuĩ anĩ dile fen terẽ douf, ere nigin, gaar kuĩ ĩ kulu ibodon, gama ibodõya sã, agef fen, fau dum isiyouf.
“Enei keleĩya nigin, kisi biya adouf. Mudur sewen are, arei mudu sewen kayau teten ibodõdig anĩ.
Idig king sewen anidi. Faif idi kuku ralaisin, taka fau ibodok, taka fau isiya sã. Anĩ ere, ĩ isiyouf are, sain naal bagai ibodõf.
Gaar kuĩ kulu ibodon, gama ibodõya sã, are ĩ namba eit king, ĩ sewen anidi nẽ taka, ĩ yogo daũ fiya bun ilauf.
“Karat ten õ ulen are, ten king idi tano fau yaleya sã anidi, anĩ ere, idi gaar kuĩ geid, aua tekelei king nẽ megeir dalouf.
Idi kisi tekelei ado fen, dogo neid megeir ado totol, gaar kuĩ difenẽf.

Idi Sipsip Naal geid kusĩ douf, anĩ ere, Sipsip Naal idi kusĩ bun wal fediyouf, ere nigin, ĩ odug neid Odug ado king neid King. Idi ĩ iweignẽdin anĩ, igirnẽdin anĩ, feseya sã dõ difen anidi, ĩ geid difarauf.”
Age ye fen, engel aya irokanan, “Naan, kayau bouwa na sur fedig ĩ anĩ teten ibodon, õ ulen are, tamo kayau, guru fiya odug, teneub ganan ado, od fire fire ganan.
Karat ten õ ulen ado gaar kuĩ, idi kayau bouwa na sur fedig anĩ to orodiyouf. Idi ĩ daũ difiye ken, gemũ dinenẽf. Idi ĩ bouwa dokon, yã nem tõ difiyẽf.
Negur idi neid waud bun kisi anĩ ino di, idi Negur nẽ oroya dõ difouf nigin, idi kisi tekelei dino fen, dogo neid tano gaar kuĩ difenẽf, age difef dile mog, Negur nẽ od kisi falauf.
Kayau õ ulen are, taun odug, tenebur nẽ king neid mudur ibodok anĩ.”
